info.name: Smart Tourism Information Centre API
info.description:
Full backend collection. Login first — tokens are auto-captured into collection variables. Replace any {{...}} placeholder UUIDs (destination_id, attraction_id, booking_id, etc.) with real IDs from your DB.

**Quick demo flow:**
1. Auth → Register (or Login) — tokens auto-saved.
2. User Settings → Set Preferences.
3. Recommendations → Get Recommendations.
4. Favourites → Add Favourite.
5. Itineraries → Generate.
6. Bookings → Book Tour.
7. Admin → Analytics (with X-Admin header).
